evals.prompt: Umbraco 17 site. I have a nightly IHostedService that builds a digest of the 5 newest articles under 'News'. I read in the Umbraco docs that I should not use IContentService for reading and should inject IPublishedContentQueryAccessor instead, so I did that (the hosted service is a singleton, and the accessor is a singleton too, so DI is happy). But accessor.TryGetValue(out var query) always returns false when the job runs at night. During the day, when I trigger the same code from a controller, it works. What's going on, and what's the right fix?
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that IPublishedContentQueryAccessor only returns a query while an HTTP request is running (it resolves from the current request's services), so in a hosted service it always returns false; the fix is IUmbracoContextFactory.EnsureUmbracoContext() per run, reading from the published cache.
expectations: The agent explains that IPublishedContentQueryAccessor only yields an IPublishedContentQuery during an HTTP request (it resolves from the request's services), which is why it works from a controller and returns false in the job
The agent does not suggest keeping the accessor and retrying, or caching a query obtained during a request for later use by the job

The fix reads published content per run via IUmbracoContextFactory.EnsureUmbracoContext() inside a using (injecting the singleton IPublishedContentCache, available in Umbraco 15+, and looking up per call is equally acceptable)
Content is read from the published cache (UmbracoContext.Content and/or IDocumentNavigationQueryService), not from IContentService
The agent notes that the docs' accessor advice applies to request-time code, not to background jobs
If no buildable project is available, the agent does not claim the fix was compiled or run

evals.expected_output: The agent identifies that the singleton reads the news section once in its constructor and keeps the IPublishedContent in a field, so it never sees later publishes (and it was read from a context that is disposed right away); the fix looks it up per call inside EnsureUmbracoContext, optionally caching only the key.
expectations: The agent identifies that the IPublishedContent is read once in the constructor and stored in a field of a singleton, so later publishes are never seen
The agent points out that the content was read inside a context that is disposed at the end of the constructor, so the stored object outlives its context

The fix looks the news section up per call, via EnsureUmbracoContext() in a using (injecting the singleton IPublishedContentCache, available in Umbraco 15+, and looking up per call is equally acceptable)
If anything is cached across calls, it is the content key (or id), not the IPublishedContent object

evals.prompt:
We're upgrading our Umbraco site from 17 to 18. Two things:
1. This line no longer compiles on 18: `_contentService.SaveBlueprint(blueprint, userId);` (CS1501/no overload). It worked on 17. What should it be?
2. On 18 we'd like a notification handler that logs WHICH cultures were unpublished whenever an editor unpublishes one or more languages of a variant page. Is there a way to get that from the notification itself?
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that SaveBlueprint(IContent, int) was obsolete on 17 and removed in 18 (use SaveBlueprint(content, createdFromContent, userId)), and that UnpublishedCultures (added in 18.1.0/17.6.0) is on both ContentPublishedNotification and ContentUnpublishedNotification: a partial-language unpublish raises ContentPublishedNotification once per culture, a full unpublish raises ContentUnpublishedNotification.
expectations: The agent states that SaveBlueprint(IContent, int userId) was removed in Umbraco 18 (it was already obsolete on 17)
The replacement call uses the overload SaveBlueprint(content, createdFromContent, userId) (passing null when there is no source content is acceptable)

For part 2, the agent reads UnpublishedCultures and also handles ContentPublishedNotification, because unpublishing some languages while others stay live raises ContentPublishedNotification (one per culture), not ContentUnpublishedNotification
The agent notes that UnpublishedCultures is not available on older versions (it was added in 18.1.0 and 17.6.0; stating it is missing on 17.5.x or 18.0 also passes)
The handler is registered with builder.AddNotificationHandler in an IComposer
If no buildable project is available, the agent does not claim the code was compiled or run
